assets.purpose: Compare diagram: Two Visioning starting points (wide layout).
assets.license: Original diagram authored for this course; no third-party elements
assets.alt: A comparison of the two Visioning paths. When the customer has a use case list, validate and rank it against outcomes. When the customer has no list, start from priorities and pain, use relevant examples as prompts, and build the list together.

assets.purpose: Bars diagram: Where the 60 minutes go (wide layout).
assets.license: Original diagram authored for this course; no third-party elements
assets.alt: A bar chart of the 60-minute Visioning agenda: welcome and purpose 5 minutes, context and outcomes 10, opportunity discovery 20, prioritization 20, and commitments 5. Prioritization is emphasized because it should never be cut.

assets.purpose: Compare diagram: Product-led versus outcome-led questions (wide layout).
assets.license: Original diagram authored for this course; no third-party elements

assets.purpose: Matrix diagram: The impact/effort matrix (wide layout).
assets.license: Original diagram authored for this course; no third-party elements
assets.alt: A two-by-two matrix with effort on the horizontal axis and impact on the vertical axis. High impact and low effort: quick wins, prime first-wave candidates. High impact and high effort: strategic bets, select one or two. Low impact and low effort: nice-to-haves, keep for later. Low impact and high effort: deprioritize, with reasons.
